# Quality Dimension

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:QualityDimension`](gmeow-QualityDimension.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/QualityDimension>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/quality`](../../slices/quality.md)

An ISO 19157 data-quality dimension or lineage category — an open value vocabulary of individuals (never subclasses). New dimensions (e.g. a domain-specific 'semantic consistency' or 'usability') are added by minting fresh individuals, not by creating new classes ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:QualityDimension`](gmeow-QualityDimension.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
